messages:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — AcmeHealth (AC-4821) reported that a large activation batch failed during their import window overnight. They hit ~60% of expected activations and several high-touch seats are blocked. Renewal conversation in 6 weeks. We need a customer-facing status + office hours invite ASAP.
Jon Park: on it. can you share the raw error log or repro?
Maria Chen: here's the high-level failure from support ticket: `POST /v1/ingest -> 502` and `validation timeout: kv cache load exceeded 30s` — sending full errorblob to the thread.
Liam O'Neill: looks like a batching/backpressure issue on Dedicated ingress path. I saw increased mem pressure on pool-dedicated-4 last night.
Anya Rodriguez: thanks — I'll draft an initial customer note. propose: acknowledgement + ETA + offer 2x office hours (APAC/EU/US windows) + temporary credit + checklist to unblock.
Priya Sharma: +1. also request we surface activation status per-tenant in the console for AcmeHealth so CS can share live progress.
DeployBot: Incident created: INC-2026-AC4821, severity elevated to P2. Assigned: eng-runtime, cs-led.
Jon Park: mitigation plan from infra: 1) pause continuous batching for AC-4821 tenant 2) increase kv-cache TTL and warm cache for their shard 3) one-off replay of failed batch with smaller chunk size. we can do steps 1+2 in ~45m, replay will take ~2-3h.
Maria Chen: nice. Anya — can you put that into a short customer note? keep it <6 sentences + precise next steps.
Anya Rodriguez: draft below — please skim/edit.
Anya Rodriguez: ```Hi team — we’re aware of interrupted activations for AcmeHealth this morning. Root cause: an unexpected cache-warmup/backpressure interaction during a large import which caused retries and partial failures. What we’re doing: (1) disabling continuous batching for your tenant to reduce contention (ETA 45m), (2) prewarming your shard cache and reprocessing failed items (ETA 3h), (3) opening dedicated office hours for hands-on assistance (link + times below). What we’re doing for you: temporary account credit equivalent to 48 hours of peak ingestion throughput, a replay of failed items at no additional cost, and a follow-up RCA within 72 hours. Office hours (pick one): Tue 10:00 PT, Tue 18:00 CET. Reply with preferred slot and any priority customer IDs. Apologies for the disruption — we’ll post continual updates here. — Anya on behalf of Redwood Inference Support```
Jon Park: minor edits: change "prewarming" -> "warming" and add footnote about safety checks during replay: `we will rate-limit replays to avoid duplicate writes`.
Anya Rodriguez: updated and sending out now.
Priya Sharma: I'll update the customer health dashboard and flag renewal owner. also prepare a renewal messaging fallback if they indicate churn risk.
Maria Chen: action items: @Jon implement pause + cache change (ETA 45m). @Liam confirm replay window and CPU slots for dedicated-4. @Priya prep credits + update dashboard. @Anya send note and schedule office hours invite. We should add a brief exec summary for AcmeHealth CSM to hand to their buyer.
Liam O'Neill: replay confirmed — we have a 2-3h window starting after cache warm. CPU reserved. I'll monitor and post progress.
DeployBot: Change applied: continuous batching disabled for tenant AC-4821 by Jon Park at 1715059100.
Jon Park: can someone draft the 2-line exec summary? quick suggestion: "We experienced a transient ingestion failure affecting ~40% of activations for AcmeHealth due to cache warm-up contention. Immediate mitigations applied; replay underway; credit and RCA committed."
Maria Chen: perfect — I'll route that to the CSM and include the office hours link.
Anya Rodriguez: sent to AcmeHealth (ticket #83421). they replied: "Appreciate the quick response — please prioritize seat IDs 1023/1024/1130. Prefer Tue 10:00 PT."
Priya Sharma: capturing feedback: I'll include a short survey link in the follow-up RCA email: `https://forms.reedw-inference.com/incident-feedback?ac=AC-4821`.
Maria Chen: timeline notes: root cause RCA draft due in 72h, customer-friendly summary in 8h, and credits applied within 24h. we'll track in INC-2026-AC4821.
Jon Park: monitoring shows activations climbing to 85% after replay started. I'll post another update at +90m.
Anya Rodriguez: planted a follow-up template for the post-incident RCA and a scheduled feedback touchpoint 7 days after restore.
Maria Chen: thanks team. keeping this thread as the single source for customer-facing updates. thumbs up when you see. :thumbsup:
Liam O'Neill: :thumbsup:
Jon Park: :thumbsup:
Priya Sharma: :handshake:
Anya Rodriguez: :white_check_mark:
